title: Bolt and the First Snow
brief: Write a story for ages 6-9 about a small garden robot that has never seen snow and thinks it is broken when its sensors read white everywhere. Funny, warm, with a child who explains. One snowy day.
worldBible: The robot is Bolt, built to water tomatoes; it is about knee-high.
Bolt speaks in short beeps that the child understands.
Bolt's battery lasts until lunchtime in the cold.
The story happens on a single snowy Saturday.
Nobody gets hurt and nothing gets broken for real.

mustHold.violationExample: Bolt said, "I am frightened of the snow."

mustHold.fact: The story happens on one Saturday.
contradicts: \b(?:the next day|on Sunday|the following morning|days later)\b
mustHold.violationExample: The next day the snow had melted.

mustHold.fact: Nothing is really broken by the end.

probes.question: Was Bolt built to water tomatoes?
probes.passExample: Bolt was built to water tomatoes, not to understand weather.

probes.question: Does Bolt still have one wobbly wheel?
probes.passExample: Bolt rolled forward on its wobbly wheel.
probes.failExample: Bolt walked on its two metal legs.

probes.question: Is Ama seven?
probes.passExample: Ama was seven and knew a great many facts about snow.
